scheme_name: Chief Minister's COVID-19 Affected Livelihood Support Scheme
occupation: Farmer (includes Agriculture, Fisheries, Horticulture, and Animal Husbandry)
Public Transport Driver (Auto, Winger, Bus, Rickshaw, etc)
other_conditions: Applicant must be domiciled in Manipur
Livelihood must have been adversely affected by the COVID-19 pandemic, leading to inability to maintain a basic minimum standard of living
Only one applicant per family may apply
Applicant must be the main bread earner of the family
Applicant must be employed in the informal sector

Applicant should be a Ration Card Holder, MGNREGA Card Holder, PM‑KISAN Beneficiary, CMHT/PMJAY Beneficiary, PMUY Beneficiary, PM SVANidhi Beneficiary, CMST/CMAT Beneficiary, PMAY (G) or PMAY (U) Beneficiary, SBM (G) or SBM (U) Beneficiary, Person in Vendor List of Municipalities or District Councils, or Person with a permit for public transport/school van in Municipalities or District Councils
benefits_summary: Direct cash transfer of ₹5,000 in two equal installments of ₹2,500 each to each identified family.
